caption:
why does my nose look bigger in selfies?

It's mostly the distance, not your nose. At selfie distance (about 12 inches), a 2018 math model calculated the nose looks roughly 30% wider than in a photo from 5 feet.

Try it: one photo at arm's length, one from across the room, zoomed in until your face fills the frame.

The far one is closer to the face people see in real life.

General education only.
